lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit higher pixel intensity toward the dorsal-lateral transition.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating defined anchor nodes in a rectangular grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible running longitudinally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient from light (top) to dark shadow (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-chroma yellow pixel clusters (teleost fish) near the dorsal-head junction and elongated low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) positioned ventrally near the pectoral fin attachment.
